name: Dahab Lagoon

about: A calm, waist-deep lagoon protected by a reef, making it ideal for beginner kitesurfing lessons and relaxed swimming.

name: Kitchener's Island Botanical Garden

about: A green oasis of exotic plants collected from around the world, planted by Lord Kitchener in the early 1900s, reachable only by boat.

name: Marsa Shagra House Reef

about: One of the Red Sea's best house reefs, directly accessible from the beach, popular for snorkeling right off the shore.

name: Sataya Dolphin Reef

about: Part of the Fury Shoal system, this crescent reef offers calm lagoon waters where wild spinner dolphins regularly rest and play.

name: El Quseir Coastal Nature Area
address: El Quseir, Red Sea Governorate, Egypt

about: A laid-back Red Sea town with a historic harbor, offering quiet beaches and shallow reefs far from the resort crowds.

name: Ain El Serw Hot Spring

about: A soothing warm-water spring surrounded by palm trees, a popular stop for desert travelers heading to or from the White Desert.

name: Black Desert, Bahariya

about: A striking desert landscape of dark volcanic hills capped with basalt rubble, contrasting sharply with the surrounding golden sands.

name: Bir Wahed Hot & Cold Springs

about: Deep in the Great Sand Sea, this natural spring offers a hot sulfur pool and a cooler pool side by side, a highlight of Siwa safaris.

name: Lake Burullus

about: One of Egypt's largest coastal lakes, a Ramsar wetland site supporting fisheries and vast numbers of wintering waterbirds.

name: Wadi Feiran

name: Abu Minqar Oasis

name: Dakhla Oasis Hot Springs

name: Koshary El Tahrir

about: A popular, no-frills koshary spot serving generous portions of Egypt's beloved rice, pasta, and lentil dish at affordable prices.

name: El Shabrawy

about: A well-known Egyptian fast-food chain serving classic street-food staples like taameya, fuul, and shawarma across the country.

name: Mo'men Restaurant
shortDescription: Long-running Egyptian fast-food chain since the 1980s...
about: One of Egypt's oldest fast-food chains, known for fried chicken, burgers, and combo meals at family-friendly prices.

name: Fasahet Somaya
shortDescription: Beloved home-style Egyptian kitchen run by a local matriarch...
about: A tiny, no-menu eatery serving whatever traditional home-cooked dishes were prepared that day, treasured for its authenticity.

name: Om Hashim Falafel
shortDescription: Legendary Dokki spot famous for crispy taameya...
about: A neighborhood institution renowned for perfectly crispy taameya (Egyptian falafel) served fresh throughout the day.

about: Once dubbed the "Groppi of the Nile," this iconic Belle Époque cafe has served pastries, chocolates, and coffee to Cairo's elite for over a century.

name: Simonds Café

about: A historic Zamalek institution serving strong Egyptian coffee and simple pastries in an old-world, unpretentious setting.

name: La Rosa Restaurant

name: Aly Abdo Fish Market

name: Sabaya Restaurant

about: A refined resort restaurant offering an extensive mezze spread and grilled specialties with views over the Red Sea.

name: Kazaz Restaurant

about: A long-running Downtown Cairo spot pairing classic grilled meat platters with fresh-squeezed juice combinations.

name: Left Bank

about: A stylish Zamalek riverside venue combining an international menu with sweeping Nile views, popular for evening dining and cocktails.

about: A widely loved Egyptian café chain serving coffee, sandwiches, and desserts in a relaxed, modern setting across the country.

name: Koshary Hend

name: Crave
